result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, but the left walkway is narrow and obstructed by a utility pole. A faded crosswalk is visible in the foreground, but the environment lacks modern pedestrian safety features like curb ramps or signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings in the foreground are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located directly in the narrow sidewalk path on the left, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around it.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement at the edge of the roadway and sidewalk transition may pose a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the left side to provide adequate clearance around utility poles and improve accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a narrow street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks, though it lacks active traffic control signals. A significant safety hazard exists at the curb ramp where a large, uncovered drainage gap creates a major trip hazard and accessibility barrier.

hazards.name: Open drainage gap at curb ramp
hazards.description: A deep, uncovered gap in the pavement for drainage is located directly at the base of the curb ramp, posing a severe trip hazard and making the crossing inaccessible for wheelchairs.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom center of the image at the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Lack of tactile warning surfaces
hazards.description: The curb ramp does not have truncated domes or any tactile indicators to signal the transition from sidewalk to roadway for visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Drainage Infrastructure Remediation
interventions.description: Install a heavy-duty, pedestrian-safe grate over the drainage opening or redesign the catch basin to be flush with the roadway surface outside the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Upgrade
interventions.description: Retrofit the existing curb ramp with high-visibility tactile warning pads and ensure the slope meets current accessibility standards.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to a multi-lane roadway with no physical separation or marked crossings. A significant portion of the image is obscured by a heavy blur, which limits the assessment of the right side of the street and potential hazards there.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks for pedestrians to safely cross the multi-lane road.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is separated from traffic only by paint, providing no physical protection from vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add street trees or physical barriers between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve safety and comfort.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure including a marked zebra crosswalk, a curb ramp, and a continuous sidewalk. However, the area lacks active traffic control, street trees, and shows signs of pavement degradation and poor drainage near the crossing point.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation and ponding
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and a large puddle near the curb ramp and storm drain create slip and trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the corner near the storm drain

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a stop sign or pedestrian warning signage to regulate vehicle behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the sidewalk and the roadway

interventions.title: Pavement and Drainage Repair
interventions.description: Repair the cracked concrete and improve the catch basin drainage to prevent water accumulation at the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs or a stop sign to improve driver awareness and compliance at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway and improve the microclimate.
